concerns.text: T012 implements the generator for only a *stratified sample of 50 base cases*. FR-001 requires generation of three distinct variants for **every** base WBench case. Limiting to 50 cases narrows the functional requirement without explicit allowance in the spec, constituting a retroactive narrowing violation.

FR-005 mandates both a Pearson correlation analysis **and** an ANOVA with trend analysis. T025 only implements ANOVA (One‑Way ANOVA) and does not produce a Pearson correlation coefficient, leaving the Pearson component uncovered and weakening the functional requirement.
SC-001 requires measurement of the Pearson correlation coefficient (r) and its p‑value. Since no task generates this metric, the success criterion cannot be satisfied.

SC-004 specifies that total inference runtime for the stratified sub‑sample must be measured against a 6‑hour GitHub Actions limit. T030 only checks that the full integration test suite runs under 30 minutes; it does not verify the inference runtime constraint, leaving the success criterion untested.
